types.name: Mutation
types.description: Changes supported by the audience API.

fields.name: acceptPairUp
fields.description: Accepts your pairing's topic. Once both of you accept, each sees who to look for.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PairUpAccept

fields.name: acceptTerms
fields.description: Records that the signed-in user agreed to the terms of use, which forbid objectionable content and abuse. The apps ask before anyone chats.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TermsAccept

fields.name: addAppReviewCode
fields.description: Adds an App Review code that signs in to Hot Mess as its own test account (AppReviewCode), created if need be. Platform administrators only.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AppReviewCodeAdd

fields.name: addPhotographer
fields.description: Grants a photographer's hedonism_bot account access to the audience: their photos may be shown here, credited to them, in the metros chosen. Photos themselves arrive by pull over the photography provider contract (connectPhotographer), so no token is issued.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PhotographerAdd

fields.name: addVenueBannerPhoto
fields.description: Adds an image to the end of a venue's banner images: uploaded, or one of its photographers' photos.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueBannerPhotoAdd

fields.name: advanceLineup
fields.description: Advances a lineup like a slide deck: takes off what's on stage and puts on what's up next, posting "On now" to chat. With back, undoes the last advance. Without an event, advances the lineup on tonight (the venue's own or an event's: see IVenuePeople.onStage).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for LineupAdvance

fields.name: answerSubmission
fields.description: Answers a reviewer's question about a suggestion for one of your venues: whether it is right. A reviewer still decides.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SubmissionVenueAnswer

fields.name: banAudienceMember
fields.description: Kicks a member and keeps them out: they can't sign in on the audience or chat in its venues until unbanned.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AudienceMemberBan

fields.name: blockUser
fields.description: Blocks someone: neither sees the other's chat messages, presence, pings or whereabouts any more. They aren't told. The audience's admins are, in the console's Reports queue.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for BlockedUserAdd

fields.name: buyCoatCheck
fields.description: Starts paying coat check at a venue tonight through the venue's payment provider. Asking again the same night returns the same pending or paid coat check pass.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for CoatCheckBuy

fields.name: buyCover
fields.description: Starts paying tonight's cover at a venue, through the venue's provider. Stripe: finish the payment with Stripe's payment sheet (paymentIntentClientSecret, on the venue's account stripeAccountId, with publishableKey), then call confirmCover. Square: make a payment token with Square's In-App Payments SDK (squareApplicationId, squareLocationId), then call payCover with it. Asking again the same night returns the same pass.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for CoverBuy

fields.name: cancelPairUp
fields.description: Cancels a pairing at any point: neither of you sees the other from then on. Cancelling your pairing takes you out of Pair me up for tonight (your partner looks for someone new); a bonus topic just ends.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PairUpCancel

fields.name: cancelRsvp
fields.description: Takes back the user's RSVP to an event, as if they'd never answered (UNSURE). Someone holding a ticket to it is still going: refund the ticket to stop going.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for RSVPCancel

fields.name: chat
fields.description: The instance's IMutationChat mixin, when available to the viewer.

fields.name: clearChatRoom
fields.description: Clears a venue's or a locale's chat room: every message in it is removed, for everyone in the room and from the transcript.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatRoomClear

fields.name: clearCoverNight
fields.description: Puts a night back to the usual cover at a venue whose door the caller works.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for CoverNightClear

fields.name: confirmCover
fields.description: Checks a cover payment with its provider after the app finishes paying, so the pass works before the webhook arrives.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for CoverConfirm

fields.name: confirmTip
fields.description: Checks a tip payment with its provider after the app finishes paying, before the webhook arrives.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TipConfirm

fields.name: connectEventbrite
fields.description: Starts connecting an organizer's Eventbrite account. Send the organizer to authorizeUrl; after they approve, Eventbrite returns them to returnTo with eventbrite=connected (or denied, or error) and their upcoming events are imported.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventbriteConnect

fields.name: connectPersonSquare
fields.description: Starts connecting a performer's own Square account so fans can tip them in the apps. Send them to authorizeUrl; Square brings them back to returnTo with square=connected, pick_location (pick one with setPersonSquareLocation), declined or error.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PersonSquareConnect

fields.name: connectPersonStripe
fields.description: Starts connecting a performer's own Stripe account so fans can tip them in the apps. Send them to onboardingUrl; Stripe brings them back to returnTo with stripe=connected (or pending, or error).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PersonStripeConnect

fields.name: connectVenueKaraoke
fields.description: Connects a venue to its karaoke partner, or changes the connection: its standing session code and, for partners with an API, its API token, stored encrypted. Omitted arguments keep their value; an empty string clears it.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueKaraokeConnect

fields.name: connectVenueSquare
fields.description: Starts connecting a venue's Square account so it can take cover in the apps. Send its manager to authorizeUrl; Square brings them back to returnTo with square=connected, pick_location (pick one with setVenueSquareLocation), declined or error.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueSquareConnect

fields.name: connectVenueStripe
fields.description: Starts connecting a venue's Stripe account so it can take cover in the apps. Send its manager to onboardingUrl; Stripe brings them back to returnTo with stripe=connected (or pending, or error).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueStripeConnect

fields.name: createAppReviewCode
fields.description: Creates a new main review code and refreshes the sample nights. Earlier codes keep working, since builds waiting for review have them in their notes; removeAppReviewCode turns one off.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AppReviewCodeCreate

fields.name: createAppearance
fields.description: Puts someone on at a venue: hosting, DJing, performing or MCing, with or without an event. An event's hosts add to its lineup only (eventId).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AppearanceCreate

fields.name: createEvent
fields.description: Adds an event at one of the audience's venues.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventCreate

fields.name: createEventSeries
fields.description: Adds a recurring series run by one of the audience's venues or people, and puts its occurrences on the calendar.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventSeriesCreate

fields.name: createLocale
fields.description: Adds a locale to the audience: a city or neighborhood its venues are in.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for LocaleCreate

fields.name: createPerson
fields.description: Adds talent by name, before they have a Facebook Page. Link one later with linkPersonFacebook.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PersonCreate

fields.name: createPost
fields.description: Posts as a venue on the venue, one of its events or one of its series. Name exactly one of them.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PostCreate

fields.name: createPostComment
fields.description: Comments on a venue's post, as the signed-in user. Someone banned from the venue's chat can't.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PostCommentCreate

fields.name: createTag
fields.description: Adds a tag to the audience's list.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TagCreate

fields.name: createVenue
fields.description: Adds a venue to the audience: a bar, club or other place that holds events.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueCreate

fields.name: decideSubmission
fields.description: Decides a suggestion in the review queue: APPROVE applies it, EDIT_APPROVE applies `proposed` instead, REJECT needs a reason (badFaith also lowers the submitter’s trust), NEEDS_VENUE asks the venue's staff to confirm it.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SubmissionDecide

fields.name: deleteAccount
fields.description: Deletes the signed-in user's account and everything recorded about them (see UserDataEraser), and signs them out everywhere. It can't be undone.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AccountDelete

fields.name: deleteAppearance
fields.description: Takes someone off a venue's lineup.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AppearanceDelete

fields.name: deleteEvent
fields.description: Deletes one of the audience's events, with its RSVPs. Canceling it keeps it listed instead. Deleting an occurrence of a series skips its date.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventDelete

fields.name: deleteEventSeries
fields.description: Deletes one of the audience's recurring series with its upcoming occurrences, except ones edited on their own or that people have RSVPed to. Past occurrences stay as ordinary events.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventSeriesDelete

fields.name: deleteLocale
fields.description: Deletes one of the audience's locales. Its venues must be moved or deleted first.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for LocaleDelete

fields.name: deletePerson
fields.description: Removes a person from the audience. Their Facebook Page stays known to AudienceKit.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PersonDelete

fields.name: deletePost
fields.description: Removes a venue's post and its comments from the apps.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PostDelete

fields.name: deleteTag
fields.description: Removes one of the audience's tags, and takes it off everything it was applied to. A facet tag (Tag.facet) only goes while nothing has its facet on; the facet makes it again when it is next needed.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TagDelete

fields.name: deleteVenue
fields.description: Deletes one of the audience's venues and its events. Hiding it keeps them instead.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueDelete

fields.name: disconnectTicketingAccount
fields.description: Disconnects a ticketing account and stops its webhook. Events imported from it stay.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TicketingAccountDisconnect

fields.name: disconnectVenueKaraoke
fields.description: Disconnects a venue from its karaoke partner and forgets its API token. Its karaoke nights stay karaoke nights, without a session.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueKaraokeDisconnect

fields.name: disconnectVenuePayments
fields.description: Stops a venue taking cover through its Stripe or Square account. The account stays for the covers already paid through it, and connecting one again starts over.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenuePaymentsDisconnect

fields.name: endPing
fields.description: Ends the signed-in user's ping.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PingEnd

fields.name: finishRoomUpload
fields.description: Confirms an upload to a room (startRoomUpload) reached storage whole, so it can be shared. Only its uploader.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for RoomUploadFinish

fields.name: grantObjectAccess
fields.description: Grants access on a subject (Venue, Person, Locale) to a user with an action (admin, write, read).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AccessGrantCreate

fields.name: hideEventPhoto
fields.description: Hides a photographer's photo from the apps in this audience. The photographer publishing it again doesn't bring it back; showing it does.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventPhotoHide

fields.name: identifyWithTribe
fields.description: Identifies the signed-in user with one of the audience's tribes, or changes whether that's private. Private is the default: only people in the same tribe see it.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TribeIdentify

fields.name: issueVenueDevice
fields.description: Issues a one-time device code with permissions for this venue.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueDeviceIssue

fields.name: joinPairUp
fields.description: Opts in to Pair me up at a venue for tonight (only while the app places you there), or changes the hint your partner sees. After a meeting, looks for someone new.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PairUpJoin

fields.name: joinPing
fields.description: Says the signed-in user is in for a ping, for one pick or (with no target) the whole ping.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PingJoin

fields.name: kickAudienceMember
fields.description: Signs a member out of the audience everywhere and drops them from any chat they have open. They can sign in again.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AudienceMemberKick

fields.name: leavePairUp
fields.description: Leaves Pair me up at a venue for tonight, cancelling your pairing if you have one.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PairUpLeave

fields.name: leavePing
fields.description: Takes the signed-in user out of a ping they're in.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PingLeave

fields.name: leaveTribe
fields.description: Removes the signed-in user from one of the tribes they identify with. Nothing is kept.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TribeLeave

fields.name: linkPersonFacebook
fields.description: Links talent to a Facebook Page or profile, adding the person when no personId is given. People added by name with createPerson are linked here once their Page is known.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PersonLinkFacebook

fields.name: matchVenueTicketmaster
fields.description: Links a venue to its Ticketmaster venue, so the scheduled import reads its Ticketmaster events. Without ticketmasterVenueId, looks it up by name near the venue.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueMatchTicketmaster

fields.name: mergeLocale
fields.description: Moves a locale into another locale in this audience, preserving its records and deleting the source.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for LocaleMerge

fields.name: moderateVenueChat
fields.description: Kicks someone out of one venue chat, or bans or unbans them from the venue, without changing their audience access. A venue ban keeps them out of its chat and takes away their view of the venue, its events and lineups (Ability::AT_VENUE). Staff can only moderate people who were at the venue; platform admins can ban any member.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueChatModerate

fields.name: payCover
fields.description: Pays a Square venue's cover with a payment token from Square's In-App Payments SDK (a card, Apple Pay or Google Pay), after buyCover. The pass works as soon as this returns it paid.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for CoverPay

fields.name: payTip
fields.description: Pays a tip to a performer who takes Square with a payment token from Square's In-App Payments SDK (a card, Apple Pay or Google Pay), after startTip.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TipPay

fields.name: pinChatMessage
fields.description: Pins an announcement under its chat room's title, replacing the one pinned there, or unpins it.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatMessagePin

fields.name: pushEventToEventbrite
fields.description: Puts an event created in the console on Eventbrite now: a draft the first time, updated after that. With publish, it goes public too, once it has tickets on Eventbrite; the organizer's "Add to Facebook" setting on Eventbrite then puts it on their Facebook Page.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventPushToEventbrite

fields.name: refreshInstagram
fields.description: Queues an import of a linked public Instagram profile.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for InstagramRefresh

fields.name: refreshPage
fields.description: Refreshes a venue's or person's Page from Facebook now instead of waiting for the scheduled refresh.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PageRefresh

fields.name: refundAdmission
fields.description: Refunds a cover. Buyers can refund their own until it's scanned at the door or the night is over; the venue's door staff and the audience's admins can refund any paid cover.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AdmissionRefund

fields.name: refundTip
fields.description: Refunds a paid tip from the performer's account. Admins only.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TipRefund

fields.name: registerDevice
fields.description: Stores the push notification token for the device this session signed in on.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for DeviceRegister

fields.name: removeAppReviewCode
fields.description: Removes an App Review code linked to its own test account (AppReviewCode), or an earlier main code (the demo venue's), which stops working; the account stays. Platform administrators only.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AppReviewCodeRemove

fields.name: removeChatMessage
fields.description: Removes a message from its chat room. Everyone in the room stops seeing it at once; the console's transcript keeps it, marked removed, with the reason.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatMessageRemove

fields.name: removeMyChatMessage
fields.description: Removes one of your own messages from its chat room. Everyone in the room stops seeing it at once.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatMessageRemoveOwn

fields.name: removePostComment
fields.description: Removes a comment on a venue's post: its author's own, or any on the venue's posts for its managers and admins.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PostCommentRemove

fields.name: removeRoomFile
fields.description: Deletes a file shared in a room, and its stored copy. Its uploader may, and the venue's managers and admins.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for RoomFileRemove

fields.name: removeRoomMessage
fields.description: Removes something said or posted in a room, with its replies and the files it shared. Its writer may, and the venue's managers and admins.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for RoomMessageRemove

fields.name: removeVenueBannerPhoto
fields.description: Takes an image out of a venue's banner images.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueBannerPhotoRemove

fields.name: reorderLineup
fields.description: Puts a night's lineups in a new running order. Each entry stays on its own lineup (the venue's or an event's): only the order within each changes.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for LineupReorder

fields.name: reorderVenueBannerPhotos
fields.description: Puts a venue's banner images in this order. Name each of them once.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueBannerPhotosReorder

fields.name: reportChatMessage
fields.description: Reports a message in a venue's or locale's chat room to the audience's admins, who see it in the console's Reports queue at once and can remove it or ban the sender. Optionally blocks the sender too. A post as the venue or as a person can be reported like any other; blocking ignores it, since a listing has no sender to block. Same as reportContent with MESSAGE.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatMessageReport

fields.name: reportContent
fields.description: Reports a message, person, venue, ping or photo to the audience's admins, who see it in the console's Reports queue at once. Optionally blocks the person responsible, when there is one: a message's sender (not for posts as the venue or a person), the person themself, a ping's sender.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ContentReport

fields.name: reportEventPhoto
fields.description: Reports a photographer's photo, for example a photo of yourself you want taken down. It's hidden at once, until the audience's admins look at it in the console's Reports queue; the photographer sees it was reported. reportContent with PHOTO does the same.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventPhotoReport

fields.name: reportLocation
fields.description: Records the user's position and returns the venue they're in, or what's near them.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for LocationReport

fields.name: requestSong
fields.description: Asks for a song, or signs up to sing one, in a venue's chat room. Everyone in the room sees the REQUEST line, and the host finds it in the queue. Refused while the venue is not taking requests of that kind (see Venue.requests for why).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SongRequestCreate

fields.name: resetAppReview
fields.description: Does what `rake app_review:reset` does: resets the sandbox reviewer account, refreshes the demo venue and its sample nights, sets the review code and turns App Review on for Hot Mess and AudienceKit Demo (AppReviewState). It also resets the second reviewer, banned from one Hot Mess venue, with its own code (AppReviewCode). Platform administrators only.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AppReviewReset

fields.name: resetAudienceInvite
fields.description: Makes a new invite link for the audience. The old link stops working; people who already joined keep their listings.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AudienceInviteReset

fields.name: resolveContentReport
fields.description: Resolves a report in the audience's Reports queue, and the other open reports on the same thing. removeContent takes the content down first (removes the message, hides the photo, ends the ping); banUser bans the person responsible from the audience, as banAudienceMember does.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ContentReportResolve

fields.name: revokeObjectAccess
fields.description: Revokes an access grant from a subject.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AccessGrantRevoke

fields.name: revokeVenueDevice
fields.description: Revokes a venue device and its unused code.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueDeviceRevoke

fields.name: rsvpEvent
fields.description: Sets the user's RSVP to an event in AudienceKit. It isn't sent to Facebook, which no longer lets apps RSVP for people. A ticket holder stays going whatever they answer.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventRSVP

fields.name: scanAdmission
fields.description: Checks a pass's QR code at a venue's door. The first scan of a paid pass checks them in; later ones that night are re-entry.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AdmissionScan

fields.name: scanPairUpCode
fields.description: Scans a Pair me up code. Your partner's confirms you met (both see You met!); someone else's gives the two of you a fresh topic instead. Anything else says why, without changing anything.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PairUpCodeScan

fields.name: sendChatMessage
fields.description: Posts to a venue's or a locale's chat room, as the signed-in admin (STAFF), as the venue (VENUE) or as a person (HOST). Everyone in the room sees it at once. Admins post as any; venue listing managers only as their venue; talent as a person they manage, in the rooms of the venues and locales they're featured in or host events at (Person.chat.rooms), from anywhere: text, a PHOTO or one of their EVENTs.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatMessageSend

fields.name: sendMyChatMessage
fields.description: Says something in a chat room as yourself. The message reaches everyone following the room at once.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatMessageSendOwn

fields.name: sendPing
fields.description: Tells friends the signed-in user wants to go out tonight, naming venues or events, or neither.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PingSend

fields.name: sendRoomMessage
fields.description: Says something in a room, or posts there (kind POST, with a title, which can be pinned and replied to), sharing the files uploaded for it (startRoomUpload). Name the room, or the venue or event whose back-of-house room it is.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for RoomMessageSend

fields.name: setAudienceAdmin
fields.description: Makes a member one of the audience's admins, or not. Takes effect when they next sign in.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AudienceAdminSet

fields.name: setCoverNight
fields.description: Changes one night's cover at a venue whose door the caller works: another price, none, or other hours. It wins over the usual cover and over an event that night.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for CoverNightSet

fields.name: setEventKaraoke
fields.description: Marks an event as a karaoke night, or not, and links it to the session singers join that night on its venue's karaoke partner. Without a session code of its own, a night uses its venue's standing one.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventKaraokeSet

fields.name: setPersonLocale
fields.description: Features a person in one of the audience's locales, or stops featuring them there.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PersonLocaleSet

fields.name: setPersonSquareLocation
fields.description: Picks which of a performer's Square locations their tips are paid to.

args.name: input

types.name: __Directive
types.description:
A Directive provides a way to describe alternate runtime execution and type validation behavior in a GraphQL document.

In some cases, you need to provide options to alter GraphQL's execution behavior in ways field arguments will not suffice, such as conditionally including or skipping a field. Directives provide this by describing additional information to the executor.

types.name: __DirectiveLocation
types.description: A Directive can be adjacent to many parts of the GraphQL language, a __DirectiveLocation describes one such possible adjacencies.

enumValues.name: QUERY
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a query operation.

enumValues.name: MUTATION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a mutation operation.

enumValues.name: SUBSCRIPTION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a subscription operation.

enumValues.name: FIELD
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a field.

enumValues.name: FRAGMENT_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a fragment definition.

enumValues.name: FRAGMENT_SPREAD
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a fragment spread.

enumValues.name: INLINE_FRAGMENT
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an inline fragment.

enumValues.name: VARIABLE_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a variable definition.

enumValues.name: SCHEMA
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a schema definition.

enumValues.name: SCALAR
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a scalar definition.

enumValues.name: OBJECT
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an object type definition.

enumValues.name: FIELD_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a field definition.

enumValues.name: ARGUMENT_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an argument definition.

enumValues.name: INTERFACE
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an interface definition.

enumValues.name: UNION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a union definition.

enumValues.name: ENUM
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an enum definition.

enumValues.name: ENUM_VALUE
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an enum value definition.

enumValues.name: INPUT_OBJECT
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an input object type definition.

enumValues.name: INPUT_FIELD_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an input object field definition.

types.name: __EnumValue
types.description: One possible value for a given Enum. Enum values are unique values, not a placeholder for a string or numeric value. However an Enum value is returned in a JSON response as a string.

types.name: __Field
types.description: Object and Interface types are described by a list of Fields, each of which has a name, potentially a list of arguments, and a return type.

types.name: __InputValue
types.description: Arguments provided to Fields or Directives and the input fields of an InputObject are represented as Input Values which describe their type and optionally a default value.

fields.name: defaultValue
fields.description: A GraphQL-formatted string representing the default value for this input value.

types.name: __Schema
types.description: A GraphQL Schema defines the capabilities of a GraphQL server. It exposes all available types and directives on the server, as well as the entry points for query, mutation, and subscription operations.

fields.name: directives
fields.description: A list of all directives supported by this server.

fields.name: mutationType
fields.description: If this server supports mutation, the type that mutation operations will be rooted at.

fields.name: queryType
fields.description: The type that query operations will be rooted at.

fields.name: subscriptionType
fields.description: If this server support subscription, the type that subscription operations will be rooted at.

fields.name: types
fields.description: A list of all types supported by this server.

types.name: __Type
types.description:
The fundamental unit of any GraphQL Schema is the type. There are many kinds of types in GraphQL as represented by the `__TypeKind` enum.

Depending on the kind of a type, certain fields describe information about that type. Scalar types provide no information beyond a name and description, while Enum types provide their values. Object and Interface types provide the fields they describe. Abstract types, Union and Interface, provide the Object types possible at runtime. List and NonNull types compose other types.

types.name: __TypeKind
types.description: An enum describing what kind of type a given `__Type` is.

enumValues.name: SCALAR
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a scalar.

enumValues.name: OBJECT
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an object. `fields` and `interfaces` are valid fields.

enumValues.name: INTERFACE
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an interface. `fields` and `possibleTypes` are valid fields.

enumValues.name: UNION
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a union. `possibleTypes` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: ENUM
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an enum. `enumValues` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: INPUT_OBJECT
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an input object. `inputFields` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: LIST
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a list. `ofType` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: NON_NULL
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a non-null. `ofType` is a valid field.

directives.name: deprecated
directives.description: Marks an element of a GraphQL schema as no longer supported.

args.name: reason
args.description: Explains why this element was deprecated, usually also including a suggestion for how to access supported similar data. Formatted in [Markdown](https://daringfireball.net/projects/markdown/).

directives.name: endpoint
directives.description: The endpoints this field is on: AUDIENCE (an audience's graph), STAFF (the same graph with the staff edges) and TENANTS (platform administration). Without it a field is on every endpoint where its type is reachable. It is visibility, not security: @requires is enforced on every endpoint.

args.name: in
args.description: The endpoints it is on.

directives.name: facet
directives.description: Connects a module capability to the audience tag populated by that capability.

args.name: tag
args.description: The connected tag key, e.g. karaoke, music or tickets.

directives.name: holder
directives.description: Marks an interface the mixin composer generated to hold a mixin edge: types implement it to say they have the edge.

args.name: field
args.description: The edge it holds.

args.name: mixin
args.description: The mixin interface the edge returns.

directives.name: include
directives.description: Directs the executor to include this field or fragment only when the `if` argument is true.

args.name: if
args.description: Included when true.

directives.name: mixin
directives.description: Declares a module-owned interface available as an edge on eligible object types.

args.name: extensionKey
args.description: The module that owns this contract.

args.name: field
args.description: The generated edge name.

args.name: null
args.description: False when the edge is never null where its module is installed; where it is not, the edge is left out of the schema.

args.name: on
args.description: Eligible GraphQL object type names.

args.name: tag
args.description: Makes it a facet: the key of the tag (Tag.facet) a record carries for the edge to resolve on it. Null on records without it; they list it in their facets when they have it.

directives.name: oneOf
directives.description: Requires that exactly one field must be supplied and that field must not be `null`.

directives.name: requires
directives.description: The permissions that let a caller use this field, any one of them: each `namespace:action:scope`, where namespace is the owning module (or a core area), action is read, write, moderate or admin, and scope is * (anything in the audience), mine (what the caller manages), my_troupes (troupes they act for), venue (a venue device's venue), self (their own records) or door (venues whose door they work). Without it a field is public.

args.name: permissions
args.description: Any one of these permits the field.

directives.name: skip
directives.description: Directs the executor to skip this field or fragment when the `if` argument is true.

args.name: if
args.description: Skipped when true.

directives.name: specifiedBy
directives.description: Exposes a URL that specifies the behavior of this scalar.

args.name: url
args.description: The URL that specifies the behavior of this scalar.
